name: Khao Sok National Park
blurb: Khao Sok National Park features ancient rainforests, limestone cliffs, and Cheow Lan Lake, offering activities like kayaking, hiking, and wildlife exploration. Online conversation is currently quiet, with visitor counts significantly lower than nearby Phuket.

positive: Appreciated for its stunning limestone cliffs and ancient rainforest scenery
Praised for offering diverse outdoor activities like kayaking, hiking, and boat tours
Valued as a less crowded natural alternative to busier tourist spots
negative: Inconvenient travel times and long, winding roads between destinations
Encountering unexpected wildlife indoors, such as frogs entering cabins
Physically demanding conditions including intense heat during hikes

quotes.text: Khao Sok National Park in southern Thailand 🇹🇭 is a vast area of ancient rainforest, limestone cliffs, and the stunning Cheow Lan Lake, and restaurants known for its incredible biodiversity, including elephants, gibbons, and the Rafflesia flower.
📢 Phuket received 13 million visitors in 2024, but the natural wonderland of Khao Sok had just 420,000.

Khao Sok National Park in #Thailand is only visited by 70k tourists a year. It’s one of those rare, breathtaking places the masses haven’t overrun yet. Our  longboat of 6 was the only one in the area. You can kayak, swim and even spend the night in a floating bungalow. 
#travel #nature

Trying to organise a two week tour of Thailand for myself and my sister and being an independent travel I face the usual problems: to go from A to B it takes one day travel at least! Maybe going to the Chiang Mai and then to Khao Sok National park before hitting the islands is a bit of a stretch!
